latestVersion.changelog:
Added metadata.openclaw block to SKILL.md declaring:
  - requires.env: [DEEPLAKE_API_KEY] — explicitly declares the API token referenced in skill instructions                                            
  - primaryEnv: DEEPLAKE_API_KEY — identifies the main credential                                                                                    
  - homepage: https://github.com/activeloopai/deeplake-skills — links to the verified source repository                                              
                                                                                                                                                     
  This resolves the metadata/instructions mismatch flagged by the ClawHub security scanner, where the skill instructions referenced an API token and 
  credential endpoints but the registry metadata declared no required credentials or source
